verse.verse_1: By oath of the heaven, and by oath of the nightly arriver.
verse.verse_2: And have you understood what the nightly arriver is?
verse.verse_4: There is not a soul that does not have a guardian over it.
verse.verse_5: So man must consider from what he has been created.
verse.verse_7: That is issued from between the backs and the ribs.
verse.verse_8: Indeed Allah is Able to return him.
verse.verse_9: A day when the secrets will be examined.
verse.verse_10: So man will neither have any strength nor any aide.
verse.verse_11: By oath of the sky from which comes down the rain.
verse.verse_12: And by oath of the earth which flourishes with it.
verse.verse_13: Indeed the Qur’an is a decisive Word.
verse.verse_14: And is not a matter of amusement.
verse.verse_15: Indeed the disbelievers carry out their evil schemes.
verse.verse_17: Therefore give them some respite – give them some time.
